authority: CEO Round 169: 'Stop searching for the frontier of August 2026 and start searching for the frontier that becomes obvious in 2028-2030 only after someone sees the invention we discover now. The new objective: second-order inventions that become possible because today technologies exist, but that today competitors are not yet building.'
constitutional_basis: Article XIX — never optimize for the gate; optimize for truth
Article XXVIII — no silent semantic promotion
Article XXXIV — stop coding when reality is the next bottleneck
Article XXXV — closed-loop epistemic control as the completion standard

the_paradigm_shift.new_objective: What will be missing from the 2029 product stack?
the_paradigm_shift.the_hunting_ground: What will look inevitable to everyone in 2029, but looks non-obvious today because the enabling technologies have only just converged?
the_paradigm_shift.why_this_is_stronger: August 2026's feature space is crowded (smart shunts, AI prediction, intrathecal delivery, digital twins all have 2026 patents). The 2028/2029 convergence space is where asymmetric opportunities exist — capabilities that require today's separate technologies to mature and combine in ways nobody has operationalized yet.

steps: 1. 2026_TECHNOLOGY_FRONTIER — map what exists today (sensors, AI, implants, digital twins, drug delivery, thrombectomy devices)
2. TECHNOLOGY_CONVERGENCE_MAP — forecast what becomes possible when today's separate technologies mature and combine
3. 2028_2029_CAPABILITY_GAP — identify what clinical decisions become possible but are not yet being made
4. INFORMATION_BOTTLENECK — identify what physical information is still fundamentally unavailable in 2029
5. GENERATE_INVENTION — design a mechanism that unlocks the missing information
6. DEEP_NOVELTY_SEARCH — search whether anyone has already disclosed this (escalated search pipeline)
7. OBVIOUSNESS_ATTACK — construct the strongest KSR combination against the candidate
8. COMPETITOR_FUTURE_BUILD_ATTACK — ask: would a 2026 competitor naturally build this by 2029? If yes, no moat.
9. PHYSICS_FEASIBILITY — can the mechanism physically work? (Level 1-2 evidence)
10. INDEPENDENT_VALIDATION — does it survive external solver? (Level 6 evidence)
11. COMPETITIVE_SUPERIORITY — does it beat the strongest 2029 baseline? (Level 5 evidence)
12. BUYER_FIT — would a 2029 acquirer desperately want this? (temporal moat)

future_novel_classification.TODAY_NOVEL: New now. No public disclosure found as of the search date. Risk: competitors may file soon.
future_novel_classification.EMERGING_NOVEL: Not fully occupied yet, but competitors are clearly converging. Multiple adjacent patents/publications exist. Window is closing.
future_novel_classification.FUTURE_NOVEL: Built from technologies that exist today but produces a capability not yet publicly demonstrated. The prerequisite technologies have converged but nobody has operationalized the combination. This is the TARGET classification for World-Class candidates.
future_novel_classification.SPECULATIVE: Too many unresolved assumptions. The prerequisite technologies have NOT yet converged, or the physics is uncertain. Not ready for serious investment.
future_novel_classification.the_rule: The World-Class queue should favor FUTURE_NOVEL candidates because that is where the asymmetric opportunities are.
future_novel_classification.the_honesty_rule: We cannot literally know what competitors will file in 2028 or 2029. We can say: 'As of [date], no public disclosure found; the candidate requires a technological combination whose prerequisites currently exist but whose demonstrated capability is absent.' This is honest. The engine should periodically re-run the competitive/patent search because a future filing could kill a candidate.

the_seven_dimensional_moat.physical_moat: Requires a genuinely new observable or mechanism that cannot be replicated by adding software to existing hardware.
the_seven_dimensional_moat.data_moat: Gets better through longitudinal real-world data. Competitors cannot catch up without years of data accumulation.
the_seven_dimensional_moat.model_moat: Requires a validated causal/physiological model. Competitors cannot replicate without the same modeling expertise.
the_seven_dimensional_moat.workflow_moat: Changes the clinical decision pathway. Once integrated, switching cost is high.
the_seven_dimensional_moat.integration_moat: Works across existing hardware from multiple vendors. Does not compete directly with any single device.
the_seven_dimensional_moat.ip_moat: Protects the actual technical mechanism via patents.
the_seven_dimensional_moat.temporal_moat: The competitors don't realize they need it until 2028/2029. By the time they realize, the patent + data + workflow moats are established. THIS IS NEW AND IMPORTANT.

what_exists_2026: Implantable ICP sensors (Nature 2026, 0.28g wireless, 50 Hz, home monitoring)
AI prediction of shunt outcomes (US 20260115436, Apr 2026)
likely_commoditized_by_2028: Continuous ICP monitoring (will be standard of care)
Basic AI prediction of shunt failure (multiple patents already filed)
capability_gap_2029: Patient-Specific Physiological Operating System: learn the patient's normal state across sleep/posture/exercise/illness/medication, predict transition into pathological/device-failure states BEFORE conventional thresholds

Autonomous Causal Intervention Engine: not 'failure probability = 83%' but 'what intervention will discriminate between the three possible causes?' observe → hypothesize → perturb → infer cause → intervene → observe response
Active Physiological Interrogation: not passive sensing but the system selects a safe micro-perturbation, observes response, infers hidden parameters

what_exists_2026: Implantable intrathecal pump + CSF biosensor + adaptive dosing (US 20260224805, Aug 2026)
PK/PD modeling for intrathecal drugs (academic literature)
likely_commoditized_by_2028: CSF drug concentration measurement (US 20260224805 covers this)
Adaptive dosing based on concentration (covered by same patent)
capability_gap_2029: Therapeutic State Control: not 'how much drug is in CSF?' but 'is the target tissue actually responding, and what dose trajectory maximizes therapeutic effect while minimizing toxicity?'
Tissue Exposure Inference: infer local tissue exposure from multimodal CSF response (pressure waveform, flow, temperature) rather than CSF concentration alone
Causal Pharmacodynamic State Estimation: estimate the actual pharmacodynamic effect (not just PK), detect therapeutic resistance, detect regional delivery failure

what_exists_2026: Digital twins + AI + thrombus mechanics (PMID 42508673 review, 2026)
Intraoperative ML prediction of thrombus characteristics (US 20250072970)
Passive AE of clot fractionation during histotripsy (PMC10206501, 2023)
likely_commoditized_by_2028: Basic AI prediction of fragmentation (field is converging)
Digital twin of clot (academic + commercial efforts)
Force/flow feedback to operator (multiple devices have this)
capability_gap_2029: Autonomous Thrombectomy State Engine: continuously estimate clot attachment, integrity, device-clot interaction, fragmentation probability, embolization probability, vascular injury risk → recommend continue/reposition/change aspiration/change retrieval/stop
Real-time causal state estimation of evolving clot-device system (not just prediction but causal understanding of WHY fragmentation is imminent)
Passive Acoustic Fracture Sentinel (C5-X-AE-V3): endogenous fracture AE → pre-failure prediction → embolization risk (current candidate, Level 3 evidence)

what_exists_2026: Individual devices (sensors, implants, wearables, AI, imaging, drug delivery, digital twins) — each separate
No orchestration layer that understands patient state → device state → disease state → intervention → response across multiple devices
likely_commoditized_by_2028: Individual device-level AI (each vendor has their own)
Basic data integration platforms (EHR + device data)
capability_gap_2029: Neurovascular Control Plane: an intelligence system that sits ABOVE existing hardware, understanding patient state → device state → disease trajectory → therapeutic intervention → response → model update, across multiple devices from multiple vendors

Cross-device causal orchestration: when ICP sensor detects change → shunt adjusts → drug delivery responds → digital twin updates → clinician is notified of the causal chain (not just individual alerts)

mandatory_for_every_candidate: 2. What is likely commoditized by 2028? (what competitors will already have)
3. What technology convergence becomes possible by 2028-2029? (prerequisite maturation)
4. What information is still fundamentally unavailable? (information bottleneck)
5. What new capability would that information unlock? (the invention)
6. Why would a 2026 competitor NOT already be building it? (temporal moat)
7. What would make them desperately want it in 2029? (acquisition thesis)

candidate_1_NEUROVASCULAR_CONTROL_PLANE.name: Neurovascular Control Plane
candidate_1_NEUROVASCULAR_CONTROL_PLANE.the_invention: An intelligence layer that sits above existing neurovascular hardware (ICP sensors, shunts, drug delivery, imaging) and orchestrates: patient state → device state → disease trajectory → therapeutic intervention → response → model update, across multiple devices from multiple vendors.
candidate_1_NEUROVASCULAR_CONTROL_PLANE.what_exists_2026: Individual device-level AI. No cross-device orchestration layer.
candidate_1_NEUROVASCULAR_CONTROL_PLANE.commoditized_by_2028: Individual device AI (each vendor has their own). Basic data integration.
candidate_1_NEUROVASCULAR_CONTROL_PLANE.capability_gap_2029: Cross-device causal orchestration — when one device detects a change, the system understands the causal chain across all devices and recommends coordinated intervention.
candidate_1_NEUROVASCULAR_CONTROL_PLANE.information_bottleneck: No system currently fuses multi-device data into a unified causal patient-state model. Each device sees its own slice; nobody sees the whole.
candidate_1_NEUROVASCULAR_CONTROL_PLANE.why_competitor_wont_build_by_2029: Each device vendor optimizes their own device. Nobody has incentive to build an orchestration layer that works across competitors' devices. This is a platform play, not a device play.
candidate_1_NEUROVASCULAR_CONTROL_PLANE.why_they_will_want_it_in_2029: When every patient has 3+ connected neuro devices, the orchestration problem becomes critical. The vendor who owns the control plane owns the patient relationship.

candidate_1_NEUROVASCULAR_CONTROL_PLANE.next_step: Deep novelty search for cross-device orchestration in neurovascular space + obviousness attack against single-device AI patents

candidate_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_ENGINE.name: Causal Intervention Engine for Shunt Systems
candidate_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_ENGINE.the_invention: Not 'failure probability = 83%' but 'what intervention will discriminate between the three possible causes of deterioration?' The system: observes deterioration → hypothesizes competing causes → selects a safe micro-perturbation → observes response → infers cause → recommends intervention.
candidate_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_ENGINE.what_exists_2026: AI prediction of shunt failure (US 20260115436). Active flow generation (WO2011146757A2).
candidate_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_ENGINE.commoditized_by_2028: Basic prediction. Basic flow generation for obstruction detection.
candidate_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_ENGINE.capability_gap_2029: Causal diagnosis — not just 'is there a problem?' but 'what is causing the problem and what intervention will resolve it?' The system actively tests hypotheses via safe perturbations.
candidate_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_ENGINE.information_bottleneck: Current systems observe symptoms (ICP elevation) but cannot distinguish causes (obstruction vs overdrainage vs valve dysfunction vs infection) without imaging or surgery. The causal intervention engine uses active perturbation response to discriminate causes non-invasively.
candidate_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_ENGINE.why_competitor_wont_build_by_2029: Prediction patents cover the 'what' (failure probability). Causal intervention covers the 'why' and 'what to do.' This is a different analytical layer that requires causal modeling, not just predictive ML. The active perturbation concept was killed for C2-Y-AP (WO2011146757A2), but the CAUSAL INFERENCE from perturbation response (not just obstruction detection) is a different claim.
candidate_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_ENGINE.why_they_will_want_it_in_2029: When prediction is commoditized, the next value layer is causal diagnosis + intervention recommendation. Clinicians don't just want to know failure probability — they want to know what to DO.

moat_analysis.data: STRONG — causal models require longitudinal perturbation-response data
moat_analysis.model: STRONGEST — requires validated causal model of shunt physiology (not just correlation)
moat_analysis.workflow: STRONG — changes from 'predict then image' to 'perturb then diagnose then intervene'
moat_analysis.integration: MODERATE — works with specific shunt hardware that supports perturbation
moat_analysis.ip: MODERATE — the causal inference method can be patented if distinguished from WO2011146757A2
moat_analysis.temporal: STRONG — prediction is being commoditized now (2026 patents); causal diagnosis is the next generation

candidate_2_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_ENGINE.next_step: Deep novelty search distinguishing causal inference from obstruction detection (WO2011146757A2 covers detection, not causal discrimination between multiple failure modes)

candidate_3_THERAPEUTIC_STATE_CONTROL.name: Therapeutic State Control for Intrathecal Drug Delivery
candidate_3_THERAPEUTIC_STATE_CONTROL.the_invention: Not 'how much drug is in CSF?' but 'is the target tissue actually responding, and what dose trajectory maximizes therapeutic effect while minimizing toxicity?' The system estimates the actual pharmacodynamic state (not just pharmacokinetic state) and controls based on therapeutic effect.
candidate_3_THERAPEUTIC_STATE_CONTROL.capability_gap_2029: Therapeutic effect-based control — the system infers whether the drug is actually working (pharmacodynamic response) rather than just whether the concentration is in range (pharmacokinetic). This requires detecting the physiological response to the drug, not just the drug level.
candidate_3_THERAPEUTIC_STATE_CONTROL.information_bottleneck: CSF concentration ≠ tissue exposure ≠ therapeutic effect. The mapping from concentration to effect is patient-specific, disease-specific, and time-varying. No current system estimates the therapeutic effect in real-time.
candidate_3_THERAPEUTIC_STATE_CONTROL.why_competitor_wont_build_by_2029: US 20260224805 covers concentration-based control. Therapeutic state control requires a fundamentally different sensor (detecting drug EFFECT, not drug LEVEL) and a different control algorithm (PD-based, not PK-based).
candidate_3_THERAPEUTIC_STATE_CONTROL.why_they_will_want_it_in_2029: When concentration-based delivery is commoditized, the next value layer is 'is the drug actually working?' Biogen/CereVasc will want to know if their drug is reaching the target tissue and producing the desired effect.

moat_analysis.data: STRONG — requires longitudinal PD response data
moat_analysis.model: STRONGEST — requires validated PK/PD model that maps concentration → tissue exposure → therapeutic effect
moat_analysis.workflow: STRONG — changes from 'maintain concentration' to 'maintain therapeutic effect'
moat_analysis.integration: MODERATE — works with existing drug delivery hardware but requires new sensing
moat_analysis.ip: STRONG — the PD-based control method is distinguishable from PK-based control
moat_analysis.temporal: STRONG — concentration control is being commoditized now; effect control is the next generation

candidate_3_THERAPEUTIC_STATE_CONTROL.next_step: Deep novelty search for pharmacodynamic state estimation + therapeutic effect-based control in intrathecal delivery

candidate_4_AUTONOMOUS_THROMBECTOMY_STAT.name: Autonomous Thrombectomy State Engine
candidate_4_AUTONOMOUS_THROMBECTOMY_STAT.the_invention: Continuously estimates clot attachment, integrity, device-clot interaction, fragmentation probability, embolization probability, vascular injury risk → recommends continue/reposition/change aspiration/change retrieval/stop. Real-time causal state estimation of evolving clot-device system.
candidate_4_AUTONOMOUS_THROMBECTOMY_STAT.what_exists_2026: Digital twins, AI prediction of fragmentation, force/flow sensing, clot engagement detection.
candidate_4_AUTONOMOUS_THROMBECTOMY_STAT.commoditized_by_2028: Basic fragmentation prediction. Force feedback to operator.
candidate_4_AUTONOMOUS_THROMBECTOMY_STAT.capability_gap_2029: Causal state estimation — not just 'will it fragment?' but 'why is it fragmenting, what is the device-clot interaction state, and what intervention will prevent it?'
candidate_4_AUTONOMOUS_THROMBECTOMY_STAT.information_bottleneck: Current systems observe force/flow/imaging but cannot observe the INTERNAL state of the clot-device system (attachment integrity, stress distribution, damage accumulation). C5-X-AE-V3 (passive acoustic emission) is one approach to this bottleneck.
candidate_4_AUTONOMOUS_THROMBECTOMY_STAT.why_competitor_wont_build_by_2029: Individual signal prediction is being commoditized. Causal state estimation of the evolving clot-device SYSTEM requires fusing multiple signals (force + flow + AE + imaging) into a unified state model. This is a systems engineering problem, not a single-sensor problem.
candidate_4_AUTONOMOUS_THROMBECTOMY_STAT.why_they_will_want_it_in_2029: When basic prediction is commoditized, the next value layer is 'what should I DO differently?' The state engine recommends specific interventions, not just probabilities.

moat_analysis.data: STRONG — requires procedure-level outcome data across clot phenotypes

moat_analysis.workflow: STRONG — changes from 'operator judges' to 'system recommends'

candidate_4_AUTONOMOUS_THROMBECTOMY_STAT.next_step: This is the parent concept of C5-X-AE-V3. C5-X-AE-V3 (passive AE) is one SENSING MODALITY within this state engine. The state engine fuses AE + force + flow + imaging into a unified causal model.

relationship_to_existing_candidates.C5_X_AE_V3: C5-X-AE-V3 is a SENSING MODALITY within the Autonomous Thrombectomy State Engine (candidate 4). It provides one input (passive AE) to the state estimation. The state engine fuses multiple inputs. This reframing does NOT change C5-X-AE-V3's novelty assessment — it contextualizes it as part of a larger 2029 invention.
relationship_to_existing_candidates.C3_X_tissue_exposure: C3-X-tissue-exposure is a STEP TOWARD Therapeutic State Control (candidate 3). Tissue exposure inference is the intermediate layer between concentration (2026) and therapeutic effect (2029). This reframing does NOT resolve C3-X-TE's obviousness threat from US 20260224805.
relationship_to_existing_candidates.C2_Y_active_probing: CLOSED (CE-015). The Causal Intervention Engine (candidate 2) is the 2029 successor. It uses active perturbation for CAUSAL DISCRIMINATION between failure modes, not just obstruction detection. The novelty distinction must be carefully searched — WO2011146757A2 covers obstruction detection, not causal discrimination.

the_north_star.rule: Don't invent what competitors are already building. Invent what today's technologies make possible but today's competitors haven't yet realized they need. Then attack it ruthlessly. If it survives: simulation → independent reproduction → competitor baseline → strategic/buyer attack → it can earn a slot. If it doesn't: kill it and use the failure to generate the next 2029 hypothesis.
the_north_star.the_difference: An innovation generator asks 'what can we build?' A future-invention engine asks 'what will look inevitable in 2029 but looks non-obvious today because the enabling technologies have only just converged?'
